node.title: Re: How can I call a class method of the object's parent class?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: In regards to the first part of your question, looking at [mod://Curses::UI] on CPAN, it does look like the maintainer is not active anymore, so I think it'd be great if you want to take over maintenance of the module. There is a prodecure for this, although it does take a little while - please see [http://pause.perl.org/pause/query?ACTION=pause_04about#takeover|Taking over] on [http://pause.perl.org|pause.perl.org].
